author: fisheco (TIREDWOOD rework)
tool: Codex CLI v0.153.4 (`codex exec`, model gpt-6-astra), built-in image_gen tool with transparent_background=true; one call per image, no edits, no reference images, no regeneration needed
wrapper:
Use your built-in image generation tool to generate the following image on a genuinely transparent background (transparent_background true). Do not write code to draw it and do not edit any other files.

<prompt>

Then save the generated image as <id>.png in the current working directory.
styleSource: Fish prompts follow client/assets/fish/EVENT-PROVENANCE.json (naturalistic hand-painted marine field-guide specimen art, lateral profile facing LEFT); gear follows the same painted style.
verification: Each image was checked by eye on a checkerboard and on a dark backdrop: correct species/object, profile facing left (halibut: eyed side, head left; hammerhead: three-quarter top-side view so the hammer reads), transparent corners, no text, no props.
processing: Headless Chrome canvas: crop to alpha>16 bounds plus 1.2% margin, halving downscale with high-quality smoothing to 320 px wide (fish) or 192 px on the long side (shop items), alpha >=245 set to 255 and <=4 set to 0 (the generator leaves solid areas at 251-253), WebP quality 0.9. Original PNGs are not kept in the repo (1-2.6 MB each); SHA-256 of each original is recorded.
